content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text uses Isaiah 7:14's dual virgin/young-woman wording and prophetic application as the reason to leave D5 vs C5 UNDERDETERMINED, which is the situation K-S2 governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand: (1) the virgin/young-woman wording and prophetic application are senses that both stand, so not UNDERDETERMINED; (2) they are separate unresolved issues, so UNDERDETERMINED.","why":"Because K-S2 says a verse carrying two senses at once is not open and both senses stand, the judge cannot ground UNDERDETERMINED on the virgin/young-woman wording versus the prophetic application."}
